subject: Post-demo: model composition + budget checkpoints
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Riley <triley@novaloft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: model composition + budget checkpoints

Hi Tom — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can align the pricing scenarios for your procurement review.

Recap of what we heard (from your side):
- Primary surface: in-product search + contextual suggestions (low-latency interactive chat flows).
- Expected monthly active users: 120k, average session length ~9 prompts (mostly short Q/A).
- Rough monthly generated tokens (est): 45M–110M tokens depending on adoption speed.
- Embeddings used for vector search and rerank on top-K retrieval; ~3M embeddings/month estimated.

What we need from you to finalize a proposal:
1) A preferred monthly budget range for inference (ballpark, e.g., $5k–$25k).
2) Any hard constraints on latency (95th pct target) for chat flows — you mentioned ~300ms P95 demo target.
3) Confirmation on expected embedding QPS (bulk vs online) — impacts pricing shape.

Initial model-mix hypothesis (for budgetary math):
- Chat (interactive) — 70% of tokens — baseline model: redwood-chat-8b-quant (or equivalent)
- Embeddings — 20% of units (embedding units) — using redwood-embed-1-large
- Rerank / specialized reranker — 10% of token-equivalent workload (short, high-attention prompts)

For pricing scenarios I attached a short usage worksheet (novaloft_usage_scenarios.xlsx) with low/med/high adoption columns. Can you confirm the budget range and whether procurement prefers an annual commit or month-to-month in this stage?

Next steps:
- If Tom confirms range and latency constraint by EOD Monday, Ben and I will run 3 price scenarios (no-commit, 6mo commit, 12mo commit) and return an itemized $/1M token target and effective blended unit cost per model.

Thanks —
Olga
Customer Success (Sales Eng)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: novaloft_usage_scenarios.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB), redwood_pricing_playbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Tom Riley <triley@novaloft.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Anand <priya.anand@novaloft.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model composition + budget checkpoints

Thanks Olga — great demo. A few clarifications from our side:
- Budget: initial target for Q4 pilot is $8k–$12k/month; if adoption accelerates, procurement can push to $18k/month but only with a 6–12 month commit.
- Latency: chat P95 target is 350ms end-to-end (including client-side overhead). If you can hit <=300ms for the model portion that helps.
- Embeddings: mostly batch bulk precomputation (nightly jobs) + ~10% online per-request embeddings for personalization — estimate 2.5M embeddings/month initially.
- Rerank: small footprint, but high value on quality – think ~150k rerank calls/month.

We'd be helpful if you can provide:
- Effective $/1M tokens at our target volume points (45M and 110M).
- Per-model price guidance and an example blended rate given the model mix below.

Proposed model mix (what product folks prefer):
- Interactive chat (avg prompt ~40 tokens input, 120 tokens output): 68% tokens
- Embeddings: 22% (as units, not tokens)
- Rerank: 10% tokens (short prompts)

We prefer a 6-month commit if the blended effective $/1M token is <= $X (Tom didn't state threshold — procurement will circle back).

Tom
Head of Product
Novaloft

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: model composition + budget checkpoints — price calc ask

Looping you in — Tom confirmed a $8k–$12k/month pilot range (potential to $18k with 6–12mo commit). Embedding pattern: ~2.5M/month (mostly batch). Rerank ~150k calls.

Can we run two quick scenarios for Monday:
A) Conservative pilot: 45M tokens/month (chat-heavy) — show blended $/1M tokens and per-model breakout.
B) Upside: 110M tokens/month with 6mo commit — show committed discount tiers and projected effective blended $/1M tokens.

Key asks for the calc:
- Base per-model unit price (chat token price per 1M), embedding price per 1M units, rerank token price per 1M equivalent.
- Include numbers for batching and prefix cache assumptions (Tom's workload should get ~12% token reduction from prefix reuse).

I attached the usage sheet Tom sent. I can own final deck; Ben if you can pull the initial unit numbers and Karthik if you can sanity-check perf assumptions (P95 <300ms model portion on our 8b quant path).

--Olga

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo: model composition + budget checkpoints — price calc ask

Thanks — quick take (running numbers now but wanted to put ballpark in thread):
- Ballpark without commit (no discounts): chat model ~ $7,800 per 1M tokens (on heavy generation model) — that feels high because we usually quote by model family; will refine.
- With 6mo commit 30% notch, 12mo commit 45% notch (approx) — those deltas get blended below the $/1M target.
- Example blended targets using Tom's preferred mix (conservative 45M): blended effective ~$1450–$2200 per 1M tokens depending on model choices and commit (Ill attach an exported calc next).
- Embeddings: ~$650 per 1M embedding units (batch rates) with cheaper bulk rate on commit.
- Rerank: treated as short chat prompts — ~$9,500 per 1M tokens equivalent, but low volume so blended effect small.

I'll produce a clean calc spreadsheet and a short one-slide summary for Monday morning. Karthik, can you confirm expected P95 on our redwood-chat-8b-quant path for their session profile (9 prompts/session, avg lengths above)?

Ben
Director, Pricing & GTM Economics
Redwood Inference
